title: Tool result envelope, version 1
description: Reusable envelope for any HearthAI tool result. The control fields are server-owned: source text that resembles an envelope stays inside data and cannot set status, trust, or tool identity. Payloads are validated against the named tool and version's own schema.

data.description: Validated against the named tool and version's payload schema, or null on any failure.

status.description: no_match means every required check completed and none matched. Only no_match permits success, and it never accompanies a failure.

ToolError.description: Each code has exactly one message. Implementations select the message from the code so no failure path can carry remote text.

enum: Response content was withheld from model context.
